title: Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Lace A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Float through the celebration in this dreamy chiffon A-line dress! Featuring romantic ruffle sleeves and a flattering silhouette, this elegant piece is perfect for wedding guests. Its lightweight fabric ensures comfort and grace, making every moment picture-perfect!

 

Size Tips: Prioritize selection based on chest measurement.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
